data.title: 砂狼白子 · 旧校舍课后的狼耳轻触
data.description: 阿拜多斯旧校舍安静的傍晚教室，金色夕阳将木质地板染上一片温暖光晕。白子坐在课桌前，乖巧地微微歪着脑袋，任由老师的大手轻轻抚摸头顶毛茸茸的灰色狼耳。狼耳随着抚摸轻轻颤动，清冷的少女双颊悄悄泛起好看的绯红，流露出只对老师一人的全心依赖。
data.location: warm empty Abydos classroom beside desk
data.action: head tilt, companion petting wolf ears, soft blush, twitching ears, peaceful affectionate gaze
data.lighting: warm golden sunset brilliance pouring through dusty classroom windows
data.mood: tender healing warmth, pure canine devotion, and sweet quiet bond
data.promptProse: Sitting beside a classroom desk in sunset light, Sunaookami Shiroko tilts her head obediently as a hand pets her soft wolf ears, her pale cheeks blushing sweetly.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko blushing softly as her companion gently pets her wolf ears in the sunset classroom.
